content.text:
The pattern matches mp-6240 (LiIn(SiO₃)₂) alone. I simulated three candidates (mp-6240, mp-1217837 and mp-1101043) and compared them with the observed pattern.

- **mp-6240 matches.** Its main simulated peaks line up with the observed ones in both position and relative height. These are at about 13.5° (100), 18.9° (about 62–64), 25.6° (about 45), 29.85° (about 96) and 31.7° (about 57, with a shoulder near 32.3°). The pairs at 36.5° and 37.7°, and at 38.7° and 40.2°, also line up. So do the group at 47.7–49.0° and the smaller peaks at about 67.4° and 73.9°.
- **Nothing is left over.** Even the weak observed bump near 27.0° (about 6) matches a small mp-6240 reflection, so a second phase isn't needed.
- **The other two simulated candidates don't fit.** Neither mp-1217837 nor mp-1101043 has the strong 13.5° peak that dominates the observed pattern.

I didn't simulate the other six candidates; I left them out because mp-6240 alone accounts for the whole pattern.
